cases.jobContext: Senior platform engineer role at a B2B logistics software company
cases.originalText:
Jordan Avery
jordan.avery@example.com | +1 (415) 555-0148 | Portland, OR

Summary
Senior platform engineer with nine years building ingestion and delivery systems for B2B logistics software.

Experience
Northwind Freight Cloud - Senior Platform Engineer, 2019-2026
- Led a 6-engineer platform team owning ingestion, routing, and delivery services handling 40 million events per day at 99.95% uptime.
- Cut p99 delivery latency 58% by redesigning the queue partitioning strategy across 3 Kafka clusters.
- Introduced contract testing that reduced release rollbacks 70% across 14 services.

Harborline Tools - Backend Engineer, 2016-2019
- Built billing reconciliation jobs that recovered $210000 in missed invoices during the first year.
- Partnered with 4 product teams to ship a usage metering pipeline adopted by 92% of customers.

Education
B.S. Computer Science, University of Oregon, 2016

Skills
Kafka, PostgreSQL, Go, Kubernetes, observability
